observations.source_type: Official product documentation (vendor/project docs) and reference architecture descriptions
observations.source_location: Using RBAC Authorization > API objects, v1.33 documentation channel
observations.observation_text: Kubernetes RBAC authorization uses the rbac.authorization.k8s.io API group to drive authorization decisions and permits dynamic policy configuration through the Kubernetes API.
observations.rationale: Records the documented RBAC policy API basis without deriving a component measurement.

observations.source_type: Official product documentation (vendor/project docs) and reference architecture descriptions
observations.source_location: Using RBAC Authorization > Role and ClusterRole, v1.33 documentation channel
observations.observation_text: A Role contains rules that represent permissions within a namespace, and a ClusterRole is a non-namespaced resource.
observations.rationale: Records the documented RBAC resource types only.

observations.source_type: Official product documentation (vendor/project docs) and reference architecture descriptions
observations.source_location: Using RBAC Authorization > RoleBinding and ClusterRoleBinding, v1.33 documentation channel
observations.observation_text: A role binding grants permissions defined in a role to users or sets of users, and it holds a list of subjects plus a reference to the role being granted.
observations.rationale: Records the documented binding relationship without classifying its architectural role.

observations.source_type: Official product documentation (vendor/project docs) and reference architecture descriptions
observations.source_location: Admission Control in Kubernetes > What are admission controllers?, v1.33 documentation channel
observations.observation_text: An admission controller intercepts Kubernetes API server requests before resource persistence and after authentication and authorization.
observations.rationale: Records the documented admission request location without deriving downstream structure.

observations.source_type: Official product documentation (vendor/project docs) and reference architecture descriptions
observations.source_location: Admission Control in Kubernetes > What are admission controllers?, v1.33 documentation channel
observations.observation_text: Admission controllers may validate, mutate, or do both; mutating controllers can modify admitted objects, and validating controllers may reject requests.
